chapter.verse: Kaisaria khua-ah Italy kici galkap kuan khat a uk, galkapbu Kornelias kici mi khat a om hi.
Tua mi in a diktat mi hi a, a innkuanpihte tawh Pasian kihta a, mite tungah hehpihna tampi pia a, Pasian kiangah thungen nilohin a om hi.
Nikai nai thum ciangin mangmu-in, Pasian’ vantungmi khat hong pai tel takin mu a, “Kornelias aw,” ci-in a sam hi.
Amah in entel a, lau mahmah ahih ciangin, “Topa aw, bang ahi hiam?” a ci hi. Vantungmi in, “Na thungetna leh hehpihna na piak teng Pasian in a ngaihsut nadingin hong kahto zo hi.
Tu-in Joppa khua-ah mi na paisak in la, a min thak Piter kici Simon na samsak in.
Tua pa in tuipi gei-ah a om, savun bawlpa Simon’ innah a tung hi,” a ci hi.
Ama kiangah a gen vantungmi a paikhiat khit ciangin Korenelias in a nasem nih leh ama nasem niloh Pasian a zahtak galkap khat sam a,
thu khempeuh a gen khit ciangin Joppa khua-ah a pai sak hi.
A zingsang ciangin amau lam pai-in Joppa khua-ah a naih lai takun, nai sawm leh nai nih ciangin Piter in thungen dingin innkhum tungah a kahto hi.
A gilkial a, an a duh hi. Mite in an a thuk kholh lai takun amah in mangmu-in,
vantung kihong a, puanza bangin kiu li nei-in leitungah hong kiasuk na khat a mu hi.
Tua sungah khe li nei ganhing leh bokvak a, pai thei ganhing leh vanah vasa pawlte a om hi.
“Piter aw, tho in, go in la, ne in,” cih aw khat a za hi.
Piter in, “Topa aw, hi thei lo ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, a siangtho lo na leh a nin na ke’n khatvei beek ka ne ngei kei hi,” a ci hi.
Khatvei aw in hong kiko a, “Pasian in a sian’ thosakte a siangtho lo na sa kei in,” a ci kik hi.
Tua mah bangin thumvei a hih khit ciangin tua na vantungah a kilato kik hi.
Piter in a mangmuhna a cihnopna bang ahi hiam ci-in a lunghihmawh lai takin, Kornelias in a sawl mite in, “Simon’ inn koi lai-ah a om hiam?” ci-a a dot khit uh ciangin inn kongkhak mai-ah ding-in
“Piter kici min thak nei Simon hi lai-ah a om hiam?” ci-in a kiko uh hi.
Piter in a mangmuhna a ngaihsut lai takin Kha Siangtho in, “Mi thumte in nang hong zong uh hi.
Tho in la, kumsuk in. Lunghimawh kei in la, amau tawh na paikhawm in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, tuate keimah in kong sawl hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in tua mite kiangah kumsuk a, “Na zon’ uh mi ka hi hi. Bang thu om a, hong pai na hi uh hiam?” ci-in a dot ciangin

amaute in, “Pasian a kihta, Judah mi khempeuh in a zahtak, midik, galkap mangpa Kornelias in nangmah hong sam a, nangmah kiang pan thu a zak nading, vantungmi siangtho khat in thu a pia hi,” a ci uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Piter in tuate inn sungah sam a, a tung sak hi. Zingsang ciangin Piter tho a, amaute tawh a paikhawm hi. Joppa khua unau kimkhatte in zong a zui uh hi.
Zingsang ciangin Kaisaria khua-ah a lut uh hi. Kornelias in a behte, a lawmte kikhawm sakin, lamenin a om hi.
Piter a tum ciangin Kornelias in dawn a, a khe mai-ah bokin a bia hi.
Piter in amah phongto a, “Tho in. Keimah zong mi ka hi hi,” a ci hi.
Amah in Kornelias tawh a kihopih lai takin inn sungah tum uh a, mi tampi kikhawmin a om uh a mu hi.
Piter in, “Judah mite in mipawl dangte tawh kipawl a, amau kiangah pai ding a kilawm lo cih na thei uh hi. Ahih hangin a siangtho lo, a nin hi, kuamah ka cih loh nadingin Pasian in hong hilh zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin kei nong sap uh ciangin seel loin ka hong pai hi. Tua ahih ciangin bang thu-in kei hong sam na hi uh hiam?” a ci hi.
Kornelias in, “Tuni-in ni li a phak zawh ni, tu hun lai tak nai thum thungetna ka inn sungah ka bawl lai takin, puan taang mahmah a silh mi khat in ka mai-ah a ding hi.
Kornelias aw, na thungetna teng ka za zo hi. Na hehpihna na piak teng Pasian in a ngaihsun zo hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Joppa khua-ah mi paisak in la, a min thak Piter kici Simon va samsak in. Tua pa in tuipi gei savun bawlpa Simon’ innah a tung hi,” ci-in thu a hong pia hi.

Tua ahih ciangin nangma kiangah a manlangin mi kong paisak hi. Tu-in nang hong tung na hih ciangin thuhoih ahi hi. Tua ahih ciangin hih san takah Pasian in nangma kiangah thu hong piaksa teng ngai dingin kote khempeuh in Pasian mai-ah ka om uh hi,” a ci hi.
Piter in a kam ka-in thu a hilh-inah, “Pasian in mite maitang et tuam a nei kei hi cih ka thei takpi hi.
Mipawl khempeuh lakah amah kihta uh a, thuman thutak a bawlte amah in a sang hi.
Mi khempeuhte’ Topa ahi, Zeisu Khazih hangah thupha Lungdamna Thu kihilhin, Israel mite a vaikhak mah bangin,
Johan in baptaizna thu a hilh khit ciangin Galile gam pan akipan Judah gam mun khempeuh dongin a kihilh khin thu note in na thei uh hi.

Pasian in Nazareth khua mi Zeisu, Kha Siangtho leh vangliatna tawh sathau a nilh khit ciangin tua Zeisu pai kawikawi a, thupha bawlin dawimangpa in a bawlsiatte khempeuh a damsak hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, Pasian in amah tawh a omkhawm hi.
Judah gam sung leh Jerusalem khuapi sungah a bawl na khempeuh’ teci ka hi uh hi. Amaute in amah singkhuam tungah khai-in a that uh hi.
Ni thum khit ciangin Pasian in sihna pan a thokik sak a,
mi khempeuh’ mai hi lo, Pasian’ teel kholhsa a teci, kote bek mai-ah hong kilat nadingin thu a pia hi. Sihna pan a thawhkik khit ciangin amah tawh an ka nekhawm uh hi.
Amah in ‘Mi khempeuh kiangah thuhilh un la, mi nungta leh misite thu khen dingin Pasian’ koihsa mi in tua mi ahi hi ci-in teci na pang un,’ ci-in kote thu hong pia hi.
Amah a um mi khempeuh in ama min hangin mawhna maisakna a ngah ding hi ci-in Pasian’ kamsangte khempeuh in teci a pang zo uh hi,” ci-in thu a hilh hi.
Piter in thu a hilh lai takin ama thu a za khempeuh tungah Kha Siangtho a tung hi.
Piter tawh a paikhawm Pasian thu-um vunatte khempeuh in Gentailte tungah Kha Siangtho a tung a muh uh ciangin a lungmang uh hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, tua mite in kamtuam tawh pau-in, Pasian’ min a phat uh cih a za uh hi.
Tua ciangin Piter in, “Eite bangin Kha Siangtho a ngahte in tui sungah kibaptaiz loh nadingin kua in tui a kham zo hiam?” a cih ciangin,
amaute Zeisu Khazih’ min tawh kibaptaiz dingin thu a pia hi. Piter ni tawmkhat sung a tam lai na’ngin a thuum uh hi.
